## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3d9dedb144cc6f7b7cb8b65b5fdaaf7cdf132561`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md` + none

Read, never reviewed: `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` (§4, §5, Guardrails), `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/cli.ts`, `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` and the card files' `tier`, `pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md`, `seat-post-protocol.md`, `platform-readings.md`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, `packages/create-objectstack/src/template-consistency.test.ts`. Inputs: card #33923 body and comments 6895818436, 6897065634, 6897264380; PR #34006 body, file list (2 files, +131 −4) and net diff against main (merge-base `b8ac0e24`; main has since moved only `area-lease.md`, `lanes/review.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md` among the files read); #33920, #33737, #33739.

Check-runs on this head (46): no failure. Completed `success`: Test Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, filter, Auto Label, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests / query-options erasure / slot lookup and corpus. Still `in_progress` at the read: Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · CI, release and engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger. The rest are `skipped`. The ratchet and the id-lint run inside the Lint jobs still running, so their CI verdict is not in yet; the dev's local exit 0 is a claim, not a check-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Round plan (card item 1)** holds. Control cards every round, read off the files: the `grep` in §1 matches the three cards whose `tier` is `control` at this head. One starter card per command, 2-hour background cap, two in parallel on their own ports: README 〈Running the cards in a Claude Code cloud session〉, Time bullet, same content. Build first: README `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` and `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, same. The 45 min / 25 min figures are #33920's Build min + Ask min (17–19 + 27; 7 + 18).
- **Configs (item 2)**. The runner takes the flag: `cli.ts` `else if (flag === '--effort') a.effort = effort();` with `--author-effort` and `--ask-effort` beside it; README: "`--effort LEVEL` passes `claude --effort LEVEL` on every turn". #33739 is closed completed by merged PR #33767. The skill's line on `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` (a fallback when no flag is given) agrees with the README ("with no effort flag the runner passes its level as `--effort`"). "No served effort to compare" is the README's sentence. Tracked config haiku + medium and reference opus + low are the card's.
- **Repetitions and noise (item 3)**. 5 per config and ±4 of 58 are the card's numbers, stated as a measurement on the three control cards (58 = 29 first + 29 iterate in #33920), not invented. "Trend, not a ranking" is the card's wording.
- **Record and replay (item 4)**. Replay now re-scores operations: README Driver bullet, "It re-sends each turn's recorded writes to the booted app, in recorded order, as the turn's persona, before the read-back ... a turn the app answers otherwise, or one whose write has no recorded answer, is not measured with the call named, never a fail." #33737 is closed completed by merged PR #33764. Replay refuses the model and effort flags: `cli.ts`, "applies to the live driver only: a replay re-reads each turn as it was recorded". The default `--out` is git-ignored (`cli.ts` usage, README).
- **Record shape (item 5) against checklist-test §4**. Same frame: one issue per round, plain text, no image, artifacts outside the tree, one label only and no work labels for the whole lifecycle, write gate only, a fixed title shape, an ordered body, close by the seat. Stated differences from qa-run: no supersede, and close when every finding has a destination.
- **Findings routing (item 6)**. Security is a pointer only: the row names `references/security-findings.md`, writes a count and no content, files no public card. No mechanism is restated. `packages/qa/scenarios` to `domain:devx` agrees with the domain table in pm-dispatch `SKILL.md`.
- **Charter exemption**. 〈边界〉 exempts scenario-card `eval-run` records only, and the next line keeps the ask-accuracy baseline ② private. That is the card's scope.
- **The two rulings are NOT verbatim in the tree.** The schedule ruling 「你自己控制定时可以吗？」 appears in neither file: `eval.md` carries `(维护者令)` and the derived rule "自建自调 Routines". The record-location ruling "objectstack 公开仓,像 qa-run" appears in the skill §5 unquoted and extended ("带全分"), and in `eval.md` as `(维护者令)`. The verbatim words are on card #33923 and in the PR body only. `(维护者令)` is the lane files' house form (`lanes/cloud.md`), and `eval.md` has no line to spare, so the charter side stands; the skill has no ceiling. See S2, S3.

### ② Semver level

None. `.claude/**` only, no published package, label `skip-changeset`, Check Changeset `success`. `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviations on items 2 and 4: accepted.** The card's text was overtaken by #33767 and #33764; the tree teaches the behaviour on main (quotes above) and cites neither card as open.
- **`eval.md` at 45/45, what was deleted.** Three things. (a) "节奏由维护者在 Routines 设定;⛔ 本席不自建、不改频率": reversed by the schedule order, meant to go. (b) The cadence line: merged into line 7, content kept. (c) 〈产出〉 "每轮一份评分卡,附与上一轮的趋势对比": replaced by a line about scenario cards only. (c) survives nowhere and the PR body does not report it: **M1**.
- **Ratchet row: answered, none owed by this PR.** `CEILINGS` is an enumeration ("never a root glob"). The only roster the self-test derives from the tree is the lanes directory (`readdirSync(LANES_DIR)`, "lane job description(s) in the tree carrying no ceiling row"); nothing walks `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`, so the new file cannot red the gate, and `eval.md` stays inside its row (45 of 45, widest line 120 bytes). A new row is a follow-up card for the seat (the dev's option A), outside this card's file surface. Two facts for that card: 26 of the skill's 127 lines exceed 120 bytes, and the ratchet header's "the four other `.claude/skills/` playbook SKILL.md files" then describes four of five.
- **The five differences from #33920: each one checks out** (effort by environment variable; no `claude --version`; "all exit 0" with no not-measured statement; means method unstated; filed 14:09:31Z, closed 14:12:37Z). They are in the PR body, not in the skill; the card's acceptance reads "or the skill names what differs". Naming a record id in a skill is what the id-lint retires, so the PR body is the right place; the seat should know acceptance 3 is met there. Unlisted: N2.
- **The schedule order rests on the card author's reading.** The quoted words are a question; the card (filed by the eval seat) reads them as a hand-over, the triage audit vouches for the skill directive only, and the claim's `Ruling-ref` names the two skill rulings and not this one. It removes a ⛔ from a governed charter: **S3**.
- **`eval-run` is unknown to the sweeps**: **S1**.

### ④ Design judgment

- **Fresh session, control-card round, from the skill alone: yes for the run** and for filing its record; M1 is in the charter, not in the skill. §0 gives the environment, §4 a runnable block whose flags all exist in `cli.ts` (`--only`, `--modes`, `--model`, `--effort`, `--create-version`, `--out`, `--record`), §5 the title, label, body order and close rule. The write gate is reached through checklist-test §4, which names the scripts.
- **No runner mechanics copied.** The skill points at the README for flags, modes, grading and cloud settings; what it repeats (login, build first, 2-hour cap) is the round's checklist, each with the README section named.
- **Internal and unpublished.** `metadata:` then `internal: true` matches the test's two patterns in `template-consistency.test.ts` ("marks every SKILL.md outside skills/ as metadata.internal"); the file sits under `.claude/skills/`, not `skills/`.
- **Frame consistent with checklist-test**: same frontmatter comment, same "read the protocol document first, this skill is not a second copy" opening, same numbered sections and Guardrails.

**Findings**

- **M1 (must-fix) · `lanes/eval.md` 〈产出〉 drops the scorecard rule for every scope but scenario cards.** Main: "每轮一份评分卡,附与上一轮的趋势对比。" covers all four scopes of 〈评测范围〉. Head: "场景卡每轮照 `scenario-eval` 技能跑,立一张 `eval-run` 记录,附与上一轮的趋势对比。" A round of the ask-accuracy baseline ② (and ③ ④ when they join) now owes no output and no trend comparison, and 〈边界〉 line 33 still says "评分卡里的泄露", a term the charter no longer defines. The card ordered 〈产出〉 to name the skill and the record, not to narrow it; no ruling orders the removal and the PR body does not list it among the deletions. Fix in place, 0 lines, 120 bytes: "- 场景卡每轮照 `scenario-eval` 跑并立 `eval-run` 记录;他项每轮一份评分卡;皆附上轮趋势对比。"
- **S1 (should-fix) · an open `eval-run` record is a bare card to triage.** The skill forbids priority, `domain:*` and `pm:*` labels for the record's whole life, on the qa-run model. qa-run's rule is held by code that names `qa-run` alone: `first-touch-sweep.mjs` `EXCLUDED_LABELS = ['tracking', 'status:parked', 'pm:seat', 'qa-run']`, and `H13_EXEMPT_LABELS` / `H74_EXEMPT_LABELS` in `check-half-states.mjs`. A record that stays open while a finding waits for a destination meets disjunct ① and is owed a first touch that the skill forbids. Outside this PR's file surface: file the follow-up (add `eval-run` to the three lists and the triage rule phrase), and until it lands say in §5 that the record is closed in the round it is filed or triage is told.
- **S2 (should-fix) · quote the record-location ruling in the skill.** §5 gives it as prose with "带全分" joined on. Write the maintainer's words in quotation marks ("objectstack 公开仓,像 qa-run") and keep "带全分" outside them as the derived rule; the skill has no ceiling, and the exemption from 「⛔ 不对外发布准确率数字」 hangs on those words.
- **S3 (should-fix) · confirm the schedule order before landing.** 「你自己控制定时可以吗？」 is a question about timing; the tree writes "自建自调 Routines". The seat confirms the reading with the eval seat's thread or the maintainer, and the PR body says where the words can be read. If the reading is narrower than Routines, line 7 changes.
- **N1 (nit)** · §4's block hard-codes the three control ids while §1 says to read them off the files; mark the block as the list at the time of writing.
- **N2 (nit)** · #33920 also differs in two ways the PR body does not list: its Results heading carries a suffix, and Build has no min–max; and one of its configs ran at the CLI default effort, which §2 now forbids.
- **N3 (nit)** · `eval.md` line 7 could point at `seat-post-protocol.md` 〈座位 Routine 创建〉: a Routine that opens a new session gets no GitHub tools, so "自建" means self-bound.
- **N4 (nit)** · §5 "Findings filed from this run" asks for one line per finding with its destination; for a security lead say the line is the fixed one of security-findings §4 and nothing more.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-hnis9r`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7d9600e45672e62ed22f5f39374b1d9a533f3a97`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md` + none

Delta record. It follows record 6897354155 (FAIL on head `3d9dedb1`) and judges the one commit `3d9dedb1..7d9600e4` plus the net diff against main (2 files, +135 −4). Everything in 6897354155 that this record does not reopen stands as written there. Read, never reviewed: `pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md` §4, `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`, card #34012, the PR body at this head. Main has moved to `bc6b7ffd`; none of `lanes/eval.md`, `scenario-eval/`, the ratchet script, `security-findings.md` or `checklist-test/` changed there since the merge-base, and the PR reads `mergeable_state: clean`.

Check-runs on this head (47): none failed, none still running. `success`: Lint and Repo Gates (aggregate), TypeScript Type Check (aggregate), Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · CI, release and engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped (three), Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Test Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, filter, Check PR Size, Auto Label. The rest are `skipped`. The ratchet and the id-lint, not in at the first review, are now green in CI on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **M1: closed.** `lanes/eval.md` 〈产出〉 now reads "- 场景卡每轮照 `scenario-eval` 跑并立 `eval-run` 记录;他项每轮一份评分卡;皆附上轮趋势对比。" The per-round scorecard and the trend comparison hold again for every scope of 〈评测范围〉, and 〈边界〉 "评分卡里的泄露" has its definition back. File is 45 lines, no line over 120 bytes. The PR body now lists what was deleted and what was kept, and it matches the tree.
- **S2: closed.** §5 opens "维护者令(原话):"objectstack 公开仓,像 qa-run"。据此场景卡评测记录立在本仓、带全分": the words are the card's, in quotation marks, and "带全分" stands outside them as the derived rule.
- **S1: closed for this PR, code half open on #34012.** §5 states that the triage sweep does not yet know `eval-run` (true at this head: `EXCLUDED_LABELS` names `qa-run` only) and gives the interim rule: close the record in the round it is filed, or tell the triage seat it is a record. #34012 carries the three lists, the rule phrase and a self-test pin each; it is open and unclaimed.
- **S3: closed by the seat's ruling, tree unchanged.** The seat reads 「你自己控制定时可以吗？」 as a hand-over to its addressee and the PR body now says where the words are (card #33923 body, from the eval seat's thread, 2026-11-14). That was the ask. The reading itself remains the seat's and the eval seat's: this review cannot read the thread, and `eval.md` line 7 still says "自建自调 Routines" under `(维护者令)`.
- **N1 closed** (comment line at the top of the §4 block). **N4 closed** (§5 Findings line and the §6 row both limit a security lead to the fixed sentence of `security-findings.md` §4, which is "a security item is with the owner seat"). **N2 closed** (PR body items 6 and 7). **N3 not taken**, accepted: no line to spare in `eval.md`.

### ② Semver level

None, unchanged. `.claude/**` only, `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The commit touches only the two `hits` files and only the lines named above; nothing outside the claimed file surface.
- The ratchet row is now item R1 on #34012. Its "26 of its lines exceed 120 bytes" was measured on the first head; this head has 29 of 131.
- No card id entered the skill (the interim rule names the sweep, not #34012), so the id-lint stays green.

### ④ Design judgment

- The commit introduces nothing that contradicts the code or the card. The interim rule is consistent with the close rule already in §5 (close when every finding has a destination) and adds a fallback for the round that cannot close.
- The fresh-session judgment of 6897354155 holds; the §4 block now tells the reader to re-read the control list from the card files.

**Findings**

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **N5 (nit)** · `security-findings.md` §4 is headed for cross-repo finders; the skill borrows its fixed sentence for a same-repo record. The sentence is the right one (checklist-test keeps a one-line withheld entry in its run record on the same principle); a later edit could name the sentence instead of the section number.
- **N6 (nit)** · when #34012 R1 is taken, re-measure the skill: 131 lines, 29 over 120 bytes at this head.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-hnis9r`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv`

**VERDICT: PASS**
